comments.author: Massivesoft
comments.body_html:
It seems that the spt’s code of loading locales will use the first locale info as the default locale to display when the target language is not present. You can dive into the file

.\src\scripts\[Mod Name]\[Mod Name].js

, find the

“locales”: {}

section and swap the order of “ch” and “en” to make sure that “en” comes the first, or simply add the locale info of your speaking language.
